# Tennessee Readiness

> Preparedness gear, training and community space in Cosby, Tennessee, at the Cosby gateway to the Great Smoky Mountains. We carry MREs (Meals, Ready-to-Eat) and Humanitarian Rations in store.

- Address: 5036 Hooper Hwy, Cosby, TN 37722
- Phone: (423) 281-4133
- Email: tnrcosby@gmail.com
- Hours: Wednesday–Saturday 10 AM–6 PM. Monday, Tuesday and Sunday hours vary — call ahead.
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/tennesseereadiness

## In the store

- MREs (Meals, Ready-to-Eat) and Humanitarian Rations — available in store; call ahead to check what's on the shelf
- [Ammo](https://tnreadiness.com/ammo): ammunition in stock locally
- [Bear Spray](https://tnreadiness.com/bear-spray): UDAP authorized seller, for the Smokies
- [Water Shoes](https://tnreadiness.com/water-shoes): for creek crossings and river walking
- [Mylar Bags](https://tnreadiness.com/mylar-bags): food storage bags and a how-to guide
- [Gift Shop](https://tnreadiness.com/gift-shop): mountain crafts and keepsakes
- [The Nut Job](https://tnreadiness.com/nut-job): boiled peanuts vendor on site
- Fishing gear, camping and hiking gear, emergency preparedness supplies

## Preparedness guides

- [Mylar Bags: Food Storage Guide](https://tnreadiness.com/mylar-bags)
- [The First 72 Hours](https://tnreadiness.com/first-72-hours): what to expect and what to do in the first three days of a major disruption
- [Bug-Out Bag](https://tnreadiness.com/bug-out-bag): what to pack and why
- [Cold Weather Survival](https://tnreadiness.com/cold-weather): layers, shelter, cold injuries and a winter car kit

## Classes and community

- [Class schedule](https://tnreadiness.com/calendar): hands-on preparedness and outdoor skills classes
- [The Porch, Big Chair and The Back Room](https://tnreadiness.com/): community space, photo gallery and gathering spots at the store
